picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's leadership of 13 Genesis Mission projects (plus 30+ partnerships) makes it one of the largest single-institution roles in DOE's national AI-for-science initiative, signaling where the government is concentrating its AI research bets.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: ORNL leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 more underscores the scale of DOE's push to fuse AI, supercomputing, and quantum systems across the national lab system.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's role leading six projects and partnering on 17 others makes it one of the top three national-lab hubs for Genesis Mission work, reinforcing the initiative's reliance on lab infrastructure over any single university.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies under a whole-of-government executive order, marks a significant expansion of the initiative's scope beyond DOE and its labs.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: A concrete $20M NSF award for Penn State to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node represents a distinct, well-funded push toward automating scientific experimentation with AI, separate from the DOE awards flooding this week's coverage.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330M raise at a £2B valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as CSO, is a major industry funding event showing AI materials-discovery startups attracting serious capital outside the academic grant system.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: The release of Apertus 1.5, a fully open multimodal LLM built by EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS on the Alps supercomputer, is a genuine technical advance in open AI infrastructure rather than a funding announcement.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: A new deep learning model from CMU, Pitt, and UW researchers revealing how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients is a substantive scientific finding with direct disease-research implications.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI/robotics partnership, with reciprocal faculty exchanges funded by the Bavarian government, exemplifies deepening transatlantic academic-industry collaboration in AI research.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's launch of the Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program to build generative AI foundation models is a major national-scale scientific initiative outside the U.S. DOE ecosystem, showing global momentum in AI-for-science research.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)
